title: Braided localization retaining its monoidal normalization
statement: Let Q:A→D and L:B→E be lax braided functors between braided monoidal categories, F:A→B a strong braided functor, G:D→E a functor, and e:Q⋙G≅F⋙L. Let W admit K-flat left derivability and Q localize W. Suppose both localization unit maps are invertible, every object of D has a K-flat Q-model, μQ is invertible when its second argument is K-flat, and μL is invertible when its second argument is F of a K-flat object. Then G admits a strong braided structure for which e.hom is monoidal.

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedBraidedLocalization (W : MorphismProperty A)
    [W.ContainsIdentities] [W.RespectsIso] [Q.IsLocalization W]
    [W.localizerMorphismKFlat.IsLeftDerivabilityStructure]
    [IsIso (ε Q)] [IsIso (ε L)]
    (hmodels : ∀ X : D, ∃ a, W.kFlat a ∧ Nonempty (Q.obj a ≅ X))
    (hQ : ∀ a b, W.kFlat b → IsIso (μ Q a b))
    (hL : ∀ (x : B) b, W.kFlat b → IsIso (μ L x (F.obj b))) :
    ∃ b : G.Braided, letI := b
      NatTrans.IsMonoidal e.hom
